entries.def:
ἐμ-φυσάω, -ῶ
(φυσάω, to blow), [in LXX for נָפַח, etc. ;] 
to breathe into (cf. Gen.2.7, Wis.15.11, a1.), breathe upon: Jhn.20.22.†
(AS)

ἔμ-φυτος, -ον
(ἐμφύω, to implant), [in LXX: ἔ. ἡ κακία αὐτῶν, Wis.12.10 * ;] 
__1. innate (Wis.12.10). 
__2. rooted, implanted: Jas.1.21 (see Mayor, in l).†
(AS)

ἐν, 
prep, (the most frequently of all in NT), with dative (= Heb. בְּ, Lat. in, with abl.). 
__I. Of place, with dative of thing(s), of person(s), in, within, on, at, by, among: ἐν τ. πόλει, Luk.7.37 τ. οφθαλμῷ, Mat.7.3 τ. κοιλίᾳ, Mat.12.40 τ. ὄρει, 2Pe.1.18 τ. θρόνῳ, Rev.3.21 τ. δεξιᾷ τ. θεοῦ, Rom.8.34 ἐν ἡμῖν Abbott-Smith has ὑμῖν., Luk.1.1 of books, ἐν τ. βιβλίῳ, Gal.3.10 τ. νόμῳ, Mat.12.5, al.; ἐν τοῖς τ.…

ἐν-αγκαλίζομαι
(ἀγκάλη), [in LXX for חִבֻּק pi., Pro.6.10; 24.33 * ;] 
to take into one's arms: Mrk.9.36; 10.16.†
(AS)

ἐν-άλιος, -ον
(also -α, -ον; ἅλς, the sea), 
of the sea: τὰ ἐ., marine creatures, Jas.3.7.†
(AS)

ἔν-αντι 
adv., 
a κοινή word (MM, Exp., xii), 
before; as prep., with genitive: Luk.1.8, Act.7.10 (WH, ἐναντίον), Act.8.21.†
(AS)

ἐν-αντίος, -α, -ον
(ἀντίος, set against), [in LXX: ἐξ ἐναντίας, for נֶגֶד, etc.; ἐναντίον, for פָּנִים etc. ;] 
over against, opposite, contrary: ἄνεμος, Mat.14.24, Mrk.6.48, Act.27.4; ἐξ ἐναντίας (ellipse obscure, see Bl., § 44,1; Mozley, Psa.42.1-11), with genitive, Mrk.15.39. Metaphorical, opposed, hostile: 1Th.2.15, Act.26.9; 28.17; ὁ ἐξ ἐ., Tit.2.8. Neuter., -ίον, adv., as prep. with genitive, before, in the…

ἐν-αντίος, -α, -ον
(ἀντίος, set against), [in LXX: ἐξ ἐναντίας, for נֶגֶד, etc.; ἐναντίον, for פָּנִים etc. ;] 
over against, opposite, contrary: ἄνεμος, Mat.14.24, Mrk.6.48, Act.27.4; ἐξ ἐναντίας (ellipse obscure, see Bl., § 44,1; Mozley, Psa.42.1-11), with genitive, Mrk.15.39. Metaphorical, opposed, hostile: 1Th.2.15, Act.26.9; 28.17; ὁ ἐξ ἐ., Tit.2.8. Neuter., -ίον, adv., as prep. with genitive, before, in the…

ἐν-άρχομαι 
[in LXX chiefly for חָלַל hi. ;] 
to begin, make a beginning: Gal.3.3, Php.1.6.†
(AS)

ἐνδεής, -ές
(ἐνδέω, to lack) [in LXX for חָסֵר, אֶבְיוֹן, etc. ;] 
in want, needy: Act.4.34,†
(AS)
